What's new in version 2.0.1:

- Clues advance automatically after you solve each word
- Scene photos and play music refresh every 5 levels
- Smoother background music on phones (including Settings)
- Faster, lighter images and Google Play readiness improvements
- Clearer Google Sign-In setup help when a device needs SHA-1 registration
- Daily puzzle preview cleaned up; Show timer option removed

Thanks for playing!
